description: This file contains utility functions and classes for parsing and extracting information from HTML content, including DOM parsing, headline and title extraction, and matching block extraction.

methods.description: Returns a simple parsed HTML document with a div element.

methods.description: Decodes and returns the inner text content of an HTML element.
